item.title: Ransomware gang hits hospital in Antwerp, Belgium
item.description: A ransomware group disrupted IT systems at a hospital in Antwerp. The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium is investigating. Patients were redirected to nearby facilities while systems are restored.

item.title: Critical zero-day exploited in popular VPN worldwide
item.description: Attackers are exploiting a critical zero-day vulnerability in a widely used VPN appliance. Vendors have issued emergency patches. Administrators are urged to update immediately.

item.title: Weekly threat roundup
item.description: A summary of this week's notable security incidents around the globe.
